text: Finn's band playing the Hope & Anchor Friday 14 Nov, doors 8. He's dead nervous, first gig with the new drummer, and they only had two rehearsals together because the drummer was away in Spain. His girlfriend Anya is doing the merch table. Text him good luck that afternoon and try to get there before the support act.
Chioma lives in Peckham now, moved in with her sister Ngozi. Works at the council in planning.
pick up dry cleaning tmrw, pay council tax before the 1st
Liam ran the Cardiff half on Sunday, 1:52 apparently. Ask him how the knee held up

So Angela's daughter has her grade 5 piano recital on the 3rd of December at St Mark's. Angela says she's practising every night and is terrified. I said I'd come along. Must remember to bring flowers for the kid afterwards.
Reza - accountant at Deloitte, wife Parisa, two boys (8 and 11). Lives out in Harrow.
Vanessa and her husband Paolo are off to see Hamilton next Tuesday for their anniversary. She's never seen it, very excited.

Neha's 5-a-side final got cancelled, pitch flooded. Rescheduled for 22/11 apparently, which clashes with her cousin's wedding so she might not even play. She's annoyed because she's been top scorer all season and the team's relying on her. Her boss has also got her working Saturdays now, so she's knackered.
book MOT, car's due 28/10. also new wiper blades

Shreya told me her brother Arjun is in the school play, he's the lead, opening night Thursday. Her mum's flying in from Pune to watch, arrives Wednesday, and is staying till the end of the month. Shreya's a bit stressed about it, small flat, and her mum hates the cold. Arjun's apparently been rehearsing lines at breakfast for weeks.
Ann works nights at the Royal Free, A&E. Husband Thomas is a postman. Dog called Biscuit, a very fat beagle.
Isabel's choir competition is this weekend in Manchester. Wish her luck Friday night!
Jakub said the darts league starts again in a fortnight. He's captain this year. Not my thing but good to know.
Salma is vegan, her partner Yusuf isn't. They live above the bakery on Mill Road. She teaches year 4 at St Anne's.
note to self: gym membership renews 5th of Jan, cancel before then if I'm not going
Called Krisztina. Her son Dominik got into the county under 14s football team! First match is Saturday 8 Nov. Should send congrats to Dominik via her.
ximena's flamenco show was amazing last night. her sister was there too, Lucia I think. tell ximena the photos came out well and send them
Imogen is from Bristol originally, parents still there. She's a vet now, small animals mostly. Has two cats, Pickle and Moose.
Kasia - triathlon in Kraków on 14 June. Training for months, her coach thinks she can podium.

Isaac mentioned his dad, Uncle Ray as everyone calls him, is retiring end of March after 40 years on the buses. Party at the Red Lion, probably the 29th. Isaac's doing a speech and is properly worried about it, he hates public speaking. Ray loves fishing and has been hinting at a new rod for ages, so the family's chipping in. Ask Isaac if I can put in too.
Keisha's Debate team in the regional final next Wednesday. She's really anxious about her opening speech, says she freezes up. Message her Tuesday evening, keep it light.
Petra lives in Leeds, Headingley. Works remote for a fintech. Partner is Tiago, Portuguese, they met at uni.
Vera's hip op went fine. Back home since Monday, her daughter is staying with her for a week. I should pop round with soup on Thursday maybe.
Hemi - rugby, plays prop for the Saracens amateur side. Match every other Saturday.
Esther's pub quiz team won the league! Final was on the 9th. Her husband Pieter doesn't even go, he just does the cryptic crosswords at home lol
Must renew passport. Expires 11/03 and the Lisbon trip is April.
Anya Moreau - new neighbour at 42, moved from Lyon. Teaches French at the college. Has a toddler, Léo.
Jamal is running the London Marathon in April for the hospice where his mum was. Sponsor him when the page goes up.
Miriam's grandson has a violin recital Sat 15th. She asked if I'd drive her. I'm taking her, pick her up at 1.

Finn again - gig went really well apparently, sold out. He's buzzing. Ask what's next for them. He said a promoter came up afterwards about a support slot in Bristol in the new year, nothing confirmed. Also his mum Liz was there, first time she's seen him play, and she cried apparently.

so um I was chatting to Thomas at the school gate and he said his eldest, Mia, is doing the cross country county champs tomorrow, and she's been sick with nerves all week, poor thing, so yeah maybe text him tomorrow evening to see how she got on
Reza's birthday 17 Feb. He's been on about wanting a proper chess set, wooden one. Vouchers for Waterstones would also go down well.
bins out tues. recycling weds this week bc of the bank holiday
Angela's sister Bernadette is coming over from Dublin for Christmas. Staying three weeks.
Chioma's work 10k was meant to be this Sunday but it's off, the organiser pulled out. She's gutted, she'd trained loads.
Liam and his girlfriend Neha are doing a pottery competition thing at the Mill on 6/12. Both very competitive. Go and watch maybe?

Dictated: Vanessa said her mum is in hospital again, chest infection, they're hoping she's out by Friday. Vanessa sounded exhausted. Call her this weekend to check in. Also, don't forget her son Kai has his football trial on the 2nd of November.

Shreya - lives in Croydon, works in HR at John Lewis. Allergic to nuts. Huge Arsenal fan, season ticket, goes to every home game with her dad. Her husband is Jamal, they live round the corner from the park. Into bouldering too, goes Wednesday nights.
Got tickets for the Arctic Monkeys at the O2 on 19 March. Booked a hotel for the night too.
Isabel's brother Matteo is getting married in Sicily next September. She's a bridesmaid and already stressing about the speech.
Krisztina's husband, Gábor, works for Rolls-Royce in Derby. They have a Labrador, Bodza. Kids at the grammar.
Paolo Costa - 'Pao' to everyone - is in the amateur dramatics production of Twelfth Night, plays Malvolio. Runs Thurs to Sat next week. Buy tickets for Saturday before they go.
Keisha passed her driving test this morning! Third go. Get her a card.
Jakub's girlfriend Ola has a big swimming gala on 30th Nov, county level. He said she's quietly confident.
Salma's school nativity is 12 Dec, she's directing it. Yusuf's making the costumes, bless him.
Note: return Amazon parcel by Friday, drop-off at the Co-op. And get stamps.

Imogen mentioned her dad's 70th is on 4 January, family's doing a meal at the Ivy. She's organising and it's all on her, a bit overwhelmed. Maybe offer to help with the cake? Her dad loves lemon drizzle.
Kasia's mum lives in Gdańsk, dad passed a few years ago. She has one brother, Piotr, in Glasgow.
Hemi had his match cancelled Saturday, frozen pitch. Next one's in a fortnight.
Esther - asked about the allotment, she's growing squash this year. Retired teacher, lives on Cedar Close with Pieter.

Petra said Tiago's band is playing a festival in Porto in July. She's going out with him, ten days, then they're driving down to the Algarve to see his grandparents. First time she's meeting them. She's learning Portuguese on Duolingo and is nervous about it, says her accent is awful. Remember to ask her about it when they're back.
Must ring the plumber about the boiler, Monday at the latest. Then sort the car insurance renewal, due 2nd Nov.
Ann's daughter Ruby has her ballet exam next Thursday, grade 3. Ruby keeps crying about it. Ann's more nervous than her tbh. Text Ann Thursday morning.
Isaac - just got the job at the BBC, sound engineer, starts 1st December. Proper dream job. Need to congratulate him properly, drinks maybe next weekend.
Vera's late husband was a church organist. She still goes to every recital at St Peter's, first Sunday of the month.
Miriam and her husband Saul are doing the Edinburgh trip this weekend, catching the Fringe leftovers. Ask them how it was on Monday.

Tiago's mum Fernanda is visiting from Lisbon 3rd-17th Nov. He's slightly dreading it. Also he's got the cup semi on Wednesday the 5th, kick off 7:30, and his ankle's still dodgy from the last game. Text him Tuesday night to see if he's actually playing.
long day. grocery shop sat morning, batch cook sunday, then finally hang those shelves
Yusuf works at the airport, baggage handling, shifts all over the place. Grew up in Luton, his parents still live there.

Jamal said his sister Amina's graduating from Leeds on 18 July, he's dead proud. Their whole family's going, the grandparents are coming over from Nairobi for it. She did English and Politics and has already got a place on a teaching course in September. Get her a card and send it through Jamal before then.
